actions.requiredEvidence: Issuer/depository action ID, terms/ratio/rounding, record/allocation/credit dates, account quantity and current status
actions.boundary: Legal entitlement, allocated pending shares, credited ordinary and tradable quantity are different facts

actions.requiredEvidence: Exact legal action/terms, account allocation and quantity/rounding/lifecycle evidence

Rights are not ordinary shares; subscription obligations/cash must not be omitted; no automatic equivalent pricing

actions.requiredEvidence: Instrument/action identity, official ratio/effective date, account quantity adjustment and RAWprice alignment

actions.requiredEvidence: Origin entitlement/action/allocation ID, disjoint pending/ordinary quantities and dated credit/trading notices

actions.requiredEvidence: Exact originating trade/claim/event, settlement reference/date/account and quantity/cash legs

actions.requiredEvidence: Dated account status plus applicable exchange/depository/broker restriction/release evidence
